{"next":"check_bill_of_lading","why":"The tracer's chain links lot PK260908004 to LPN L32611596 via shipment SHP-42804. However, the WMS vendor_lot for that LPN is recorded as PK-260908-004. Per the known quirks, vendor_lot codes may suffer formatting drift (e.g., leading zeros omitted) relative to upstream supplier_lot values. The BOL index (OCF-26-47805) is the authoritative carrier record that bridges the packer shipment and the physical movement; verifying it will confirm whether the lot code variance is a trivial formatting difference or indicates a different product, resolving the 'no receiving record' gap."}
